locked.va_psf_note: Closed-sale median price per sq ft from Redfin county market tracker. No API key. Asking-price FRED/Realtor.com series not used.
locked.va_rent_note: Official HUD Fair Market Rent, 2-bedroom, FY2026. Dollars per month, not per sq ft. Census ACS skipped because the API requires a key.
locked.mumbai_sale_note: IGR Maharashtra Annual Statement of Rates (ready reckoner) FY 2025-26 / frozen FY 2026-27, compiled to 24 BMC wards as the midpoint of published residential ₹/sq m ranges, converted to ₹/sq ft. Residex has no public API. Ward GeoJSON is the grain we can draw.
locked.mumbai_rent_note: No official locality rent ₹/sq ft. City KPI uses Magicbricks Mumbai Rent Index 2BHK average as a named research exception. Not mapped onto wards.
locked.refresh_note: Static Firebase site. No HUD/Census/FRED keys in client JS. Re-run scripts/refresh-housing.py when vintages change.
